# Zordra Works

Zordra Works develops ClearPath Customs, an AI-driven customs clearance solution designed to streamline documentation and ensure compliance for maritime port operations. Targeted primarily at logistics providers and customs brokerage firms, ClearPath Customs automates the complex paperwork and regulatory checks required for smooth container handling and shipping, reducing delays and penalties.

Since launching in early 2022, ClearPath Customs has processed over 150,000 shipments with a 98% first-pass compliance rate, significantly improving clearance speed and accuracy. The company completed a $7 million Series A round led by Harbor Ventures in March 2024, fueling expansion into Southeast Asia and integration with major port operators.

The Zordra Works team includes co-founders CEO Kelmere Lin, CTO Dramere Dorow, and VP of Product Sofia Morales, alongside a 25-member engineering and customer success staff. Key competitors include DockLogic and CargoSense, both offering customs-related software but with less AI integration and lower compliance scores.

Open risks involve evolving international trade regulations that may require rapid software updates, as well as dependency on port data integration agreements that can delay deployments.
